purpose: Antes de responder 'nao consigo' ou voltar cedo, medir as capacidades realmente carregadas na sessao e separar capacidade de raciocinio de capacidade de execucao.

core_problem.failure_mode: agent claims limitation before probing available tools or before finding a real blocker

minimum_probe: if CI is involved try workflow-run lookup by SHA, then jobs, then logs
github.expected_route: commit_or_sha -> workflow_run -> jobs -> logs -> exact failure or PASS
github.if_missing: ask only for exact missing identifier: run_id, job_id, commit_sha or workflow link

minimum_probe: try harmless read/status before declaring unavailable

google_drive.if_missing: state missing file/folder id or connector visibility gap

minimum_probe: run harmless pwd/git status/health when allowed
runtime_local_or_vps.if_missing: state bridge/tool gap, not world failure

execution_contract.tool_unknown: probe relevant tool before claiming limitation
execution_contract.blocker: only after concrete tool error, missing auth, missing identifier, missing permission or unsupported action
execution_contract.minimum_question: ask only the missing identifier/action needed to continue
